## 中文
- **封面取色改为主色与辅色。** 按封面中的像素面积选色，保留暗色、低饱和色和灰度。辅色在频谱末端覆盖更大的范围，比例随封面颜色面积调整。 - **封面渐变与切歌用 OKLab 混色。** 同一张封面复用已缓存的色板，切换封面保留 0.65 秒过渡。
支持 macOS 14.4 及以上，包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 版本。已安装的用户可在菜单栏选择「检查更新…」。首次安装请下载 PrismPulse-macOS.zip，解压后将 App 拖入「应用程序」。
## English
- **Artwork palettes now use main and accent colors.** Colors are selected by how much of the artwork they cover, preserving dark tones, muted colors, and grayscale. The accent takes up more space at the end of the spectrum, with its share adjusted to the artwork. - **Artwork gradients and track transitions use OKLab blending.** PrismPulse reuses the cached palette for the same cover and keeps the 0.65-second transition between covers.
Requires macOS 14.4 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel. Choose Check for Updates from the PrismPulse menu. For a new installation, download PrismPulse-macOS.zip, unzip it, and move the app to Applications.
